summary: Card Library: the Owned numeral under each card is click-to-edit. Clicking it opens a number field with a green check (accept) and red x (revert); Enter and clicking elsewhere accept, Esc reverts. Writes through the shared collection store.
validation: Client builds; native MyCollectionProbe run (real mouse and key events): 43 assertions pass, including 7 new ones for open/check/Esc/x/Enter/click-elsewhere/zero; screenshot checked. Also fixed the probe's export-header check left stale by #1142.
remaining: Deck Builder's Owned labels are not editable (not requested). Not tried by hand on Windows beyond the native probe.
